notes: Section: 'Appendix.' heading on p. 203 (footnote 1) under the 42nd declaration; read from line numeral '2.' (ànet') to the last word at the bottom of p. 208 (seśet 'the fire,', line 27). Line numerals 2-27 are printed inline; numerals '11.' (p. 205, inside mert - f) and '27.' (p. 208, inside seśeṭ - nà) fall inside a word: those words are assigned to the preceding line. Running heads: p. 203/205/207 'B.D. Chap. CXXV.' (p. 203 '-Confession.]'); p. 204/206/208 'THE BOOK OF THE DEAD. [Plate XXXII.' - excluded. Budge sometimes prints two transliterations under one gloss ('ḥer entet' = because, 'ḥer mā' = forthwith, 'peti trà' = What then, 'pe trà àref'); these are split into their sign groups, the gloss given to the first. p. 205 line 13: transliteration 'en' (by) at the end of the row has no hieroglyph above it (signs []). p. 205 line 13 't'eṭet' (speech) is printed with md-t signs (S43, D46). Square brackets in the hieroglyph line: p. 205 àb - [à] (suffix A1 bracketed); p. 208 line 25 a bracket encloses àu ... ṭes; p. 208 line 25 seśet has an opening '[' with no visible closing bracket. A tall, broken (dashed-looking) vertical stroke is frequent after determinatives; coded Z1. The suffix/seated-man figure almost always has one arm raised; coded A1 per house ruling. The flat bar with a small tie mark under the cobra in t'eṭ / ànet' and in maāt / em-baḥ is coded Y1 (distinct from the D46 hand seen in md-t, Ḥepṭ-re, seśeṭ). The forearm in erṭā is printed flat without a visible loaf in several places (coded D37 per house ruling); in ṭā - f (p. 206) and ṭāu (p. 207) the loaf is visible. No rubrics (overlining) seen in this range. No damage; print is clean.
